manifesto.p1: A team of ten pays $6,000 a year for a CRM, $1,440 to book meetings and $420 to shorten links. Those prices are set per head or per plan.
manifesto.p2: Running that software costs far less. All twenty-one zerosoft apps fit in one container and one SQLite file on a small server.
manifesto.p3: So we publish the code. The core of every app is AGPLv3: you can read it, change it and run it on your server without paying us.
manifesto.p4: If you would rather we run it, zerosoft Cloud bills per workspace, by usage. Adding someone to the team does not change the bill.
manifesto.p5: We started with the tools small teams pay the most for. What is missing is written down in the roadmap, and what ships goes in the changelog.

oss.title: Self-host it in one command.
oss.p: The core of every app is AGPLv3, with every core feature and no trial. Run it with Docker on a small VPS. Your data lives in one SQLite file and an uploads volume: back up those two and you have everything.
oss.b1: AGPLv3 core with every core feature
oss.b3: Your data in one SQLite file you own
oss.b4: SSO, audit logs and custom roles (/ee): in development

dev.label: Developers
dev.title: A real API.
dev.p: Create a key in settings and use Link, CRM, Cal, Track, Docs, Chat, Agents and more over REST. Subscribe to events and verify every delivery with an HMAC signature.
dev.b1: Links; CRM contacts, companies, deals, tasks, pipelines, products and quotes; Cal event types and bookings; and messages to your agents.
dev.b2: Scoped zs_… keys, shown once and stored hashed. 100 requests per minute.
dev.b3: Link, booking, contact and deal events, signed with the Zerosoft-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256) and retried with backoff.

faq.title: Questions.
faq.a1: Self-hosting costs $0: the core of every app is AGPLv3, with every core feature. On zerosoft Cloud each workspace starts on a free plan and, past it, pays for usage: clicks, bookings, emails and storage. Seats are not billed. AI is billed by tokens.
faq.a2: From zerosoft Cloud, which bills usage above the free plan, and from Enterprise, a commercial license with direct support. The core is never billed.
faq.q3: What happens if zerosoft shuts down?
faq.a3: The code is published under AGPLv3, so you can keep running it on your server. Link and CRM export to CSV, and if you self-host, all your data is in a SQLite file you already have.
faq.q4: What do I need to self-host?
faq.a4: Docker and a small server. Clone the repo, fill in .env and run docker compose up -d. Data lives in two volumes: a SQLite file and your uploads. Without Docker: npm ci, npm run build, npm start.
faq.q5: Can I migrate from what I use today?
faq.a5: Yes. Settings › Import brings HubSpot and Pipedrive to CRM, Notion to Docs (with a token or an export file), Linear, Jira, GitHub, Asana and Shortcut to Track, Calendly to Cal, Bitly to Link and Evernote to Notes. You review what comes in before importing, and importing again updates instead of duplicating.
faq.q6: What does AGPLv3 mean for my company?
faq.a6: You can use, host and modify it at no cost. If you offer a modified version as a service to others, you have to publish your changes. The /ee folder has a separate commercial license.
faq.q7: Do you have SSO and audit logs?
faq.a7: Not yet. SSO/SAML, audit logs, custom roles and white-label are in development as part of Enterprise. We will announce them in the changelog when they ship.

end.sub: Sign in with Google and use the free plan, or clone the repo and start it with Docker. The core is the same.

desktop.title: zerosoft on your computer.
desktop.p: The desktop app opens your apps in their own window and does what a browser tab can’t.
desktop.b1: Hold Option + Space (Ctrl + Alt + Space on Windows), talk, and let go. The cleaned-up text lands where your cursor is: an email, a doc, a chat.
desktop.b2: While Voice records a meeting and the window is behind others, a small indicator on top shows the time and lets you stop.
desktop.b3: Mentions, direct messages and bell alerts as notifications, with the unread count on the dock icon.
desktop.b4: If a dictation can’t reach the server, it stays on your computer and is sent again when you’re back online.
desktop.note: No Linux build yet. On your phone, add zerosoft to your home screen from the browser.

myIssues.title: My issues
myIssues.body: Everything assigned to you, across all teams.

issues.title: Open Issues
issues.body: Issues lists every issue in the workspace. Open it to see filters and views.

filters.title: Filter
filters.body: Filter by status, priority, assignee, cycle, labels or due date. Press F to add a filter and / to search.
filters.bodyTouch: Filter by status, priority, assignee, cycle, labels or due date.

display.title: Display
display.body: Switch between list, board, calendar and Gantt, and choose how issues are grouped and sorted.

views.title: Saved views
views.body: Save the filters and display you use often as a view and come back to them in one click.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.body: C creates an issue, J and K move through the list and Enter opens it. G then I goes to Inbox. Cmd+K finds anything.

done.title: That's the tour
done.body: You can take it again from your account menu.

intro.title: Welcome to Cal
intro.body: Cal gives you booking links so people pick a time that works for you. This tour points out the main parts.

newEventType.title: Create an event type
newEventType.body: Each event type is a booking link with its own length, hours and questions. On this page, C creates one too.
newEventType.bodyTouch: Each event type is a booking link with its own length, hours and questions.

eventType.title: Share your link
eventType.body: Copy the link to send it, open the page people see, or turn the switch off to stop taking bookings. Open the row to edit it.

upcoming.title: Upcoming bookings
upcoming.body: The next meetings people booked with you show up here, with who booked and for what.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.body: Every booking, upcoming and past. From there you can reschedule, cancel or mark a no-show.

availability.title: Availability
availability.body: Set your weekly hours and block days off. Your event types only offer times inside them.

routing.title: Routing forms
routing.body: Ask a few questions before booking and send each person to the right event type, like sales or support.

settings.title: Cal settings
settings.body: Your public link, your brand, your calendar connections and how you charge for bookings.

done.title: That's the tour
done.body: You can take it again from your account menu.

intro.title: Welcome to Rec
intro.body: Rec records your screen, your camera or both, and shares the video with a link. This tour points out the main parts.

record.title: Record a video
record.body: Pick screen, camera or both and start. The video uploads while you record, and the link is copied when you finish.

upload.title: Upload a video
upload.body: Already have a recording? Upload a WebM, MP4 or MOV file and share it the same way.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.body: Videos everyone in the workspace can find. Move a video here, or record it here, to share it with your team.

settings.title: Rec settings
settings.body: Who can watch new videos by default, your brand on the shared page and how long videos are kept.

openVideo.title: Open a video
openVideo.body: Your videos show up here with their viewers and comments. Click one to share it and see who watched. The tour continues there.

share.title: Share
share.body: Choose who can watch: anyone with the link, only the workspace or specific people. You can add a password, an expiry date, turn off downloads or embed it.

insights.title: Insights
insights.body: Who watched, for how long, and how many viewers reached each moment of the video.

done.title: That's the tour
done.body: You can take it again from your account menu.

intro.title: Welcome to People
intro.body: People is your team directory, with the org chart, time off and reviews. This tour points out the main parts.

person.title: Profiles
person.body: Everyone in the workspace has a profile. Open one to see their role, manager, time off and documents.

filters.title: Search and filter
filters.body: Find someone by name, title or team, or filter by department, location and type.

add.title: Add a person
add.body: Add someone by hand or import a CSV. People who join the workspace show up on their own.

org.title: Org chart
org.body: Who reports to whom, built from the manager on each profile.

timeOff.title: Time off
timeOff.body: Request days off and see your balances. Managers approve their team's requests here.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.body: Review cycles with self, manager and peer reviews, plus team surveys.

settings.title: People settings
settings.body: Time off policies, holidays, custom fields, who sees what and HR admins.

done.title: That's the tour
done.body: You can take it again from your account menu.

intro.title: Welcome to Send
intro.body: Send shares a document through a link and shows you who opened it and what they read. This tour points out the main parts.

newDocument.title: Upload a document
newDocument.body: Upload a PDF, a Word file, slides or a video. The file stays private: people only see it through a link you make.

openDocument.title: Open a document
openDocument.body: Click a document to make links for it and see who read it. The tour continues there.

links.title: Make a link
links.body: Make one link per person to know who read what. Each link can ask for an email or a passcode, expire on a date and allow downloads or not. It is copied when you create it.

activity.title: See who read it
activity.body: Each visit shows who opened the document, from which link, how many pages they read and how long they spent on each one.

sharing.title: Who in your team sees it
sharing.body: Keep the document for you and the admins, or let the whole workspace see it with its links and numbers.

spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.body: Put several documents behind one link, like a data room, with numbers for each document.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: Visits, readers and reading time across all your documents, compared with the previous period.

done.title: That's the tour
done.body: You can take it again from your account menu.

intro.title: Welcome to Voice
intro.body: Voice records your meetings and writes up your notes with the transcript. It also lets you dictate instead of typing. This tour points out the main parts.

newMeeting.title: Start a meeting
newMeeting.body: Start one when a call begins. Voice records your microphone, or your microphone and a browser tab, and writes the transcript as you talk. No bot joins the call.

import.title: Import a recording
import.body: Bring in an audio or video file of a call and Voice transcribes it like any other meeting.

upcoming.title: Coming up
upcoming.body: The next meetings from your calendar. Take notes for one when it starts, or read a brief on who is coming.

ask.title: Ask your meetings
ask.body: Ask a question across all your meetings and get an answer with links to the meetings it came from. Type / to run a recipe.

meetings.title: Your meetings
meetings.body: Every meeting lands here with its notes and transcript. Search finds words in titles, notes and transcripts. Rename or delete a meeting from its row.

folders.title: Folders
folders.body: Sort meetings into folders, with subfolders one level deep. Shared with me holds the meetings other people shared with you.

dictation.title: Dictation
dictation.body: Talk instead of typing in any zerosoft field. Your dictation history lives here, ready to copy again.

settings.title: Voice settings
settings.body: Your dictation shortcut and style, your dictionary and your meeting templates. They only apply to you.

done.title: That's the tour
done.body: You can take it again from your account menu.

intro.title: Welcome to Talk
intro.body: Talk is where your team chats: channels by topic, direct messages and threads. This tour points out the main parts.

channels.title: Channels
channels.body: Each channel holds the conversation about a topic, a project or a team. Every workspace starts with #general. Use + to create one.

dms.title: Direct messages
dms.body: Talk with one person or a small group outside the channels. Use + to start one.

composer.title: Write a message
composer.body: Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a line. Mention people with @, attach files or schedule the message. Type / for commands like /remind.
composer.bodyTouch: Write your message and send it. Mention people with @, attach files or schedule the message. Type / for commands like /remind.

threads.title: Threads
threads.body: Reply to a message in a thread (↩ in its actions) to keep the channel tidy. Replies in the threads you follow land here.

search.title: Search
search.body: Find messages across your channels. Narrow it with in:#channel, from:@person or has:link. Cmd+G brings you here.
search.bodyTouch: Find messages across your channels. Narrow it with in:#channel, from:@person or has:link.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: Messages, thread replies, who posts and when, reactions and huddles in the conversations you can read, against the previous period.

settings.title: Talk settings
settings.body: Settings for Talk, with a shortcut to the workspace members to invite your team.

done.title: That's the tour
done.body: You can take it again from your account menu.

intro.title: Welcome to Board
intro.body: Board is a whiteboard for sketches, diagrams and sticky notes. This tour points out the main parts.

newBoard.title: Create a board
newBoard.body: Start a blank board here. Import, next to it, opens .excalidraw files.

templates.title: Start from a template
templates.body: Retrospective, kanban, mind map, user flow and more. Pick one to get a board that is already laid out.

organize.title: Find and organize
organize.body: Search boards by name or by what is on them, and group them in folders. Deleted boards wait in Trash.

openBoard.title: Open a board
openBoard.body: Open any board in the list to start drawing.

toolbar.title: Shapes and drawing
toolbar.body: Pick a shape, an arrow, text or the pen. Each tool has a key: R for a rectangle, A for an arrow, T for text.
toolbar.bodyTouch: Pick a shape, an arrow, text or the pen.

canvasTools.title: Stickies and more
canvasTools.body: Add a sticky (N), highlight, insert a table, attach a file or show the minimap (M). With a sticky selected, Tab adds the next one.
canvasTools.bodyTouch: Add a sticky, highlight, insert a table, attach a file or show the minimap.

zoom.title: Zoom and undo
zoom.body: Zoom in and out or undo from here. Scroll to move around the board, or hold Space and drag.

workshop.title: Run a workshop
workshop.body: Start a timer everyone sees, open a dot voting round on the stickies, or turn on private mode so ideas stay hidden until you reveal them. When the bar is narrow, Workshop is in the More menu.

share.title: Share
share.body: Turn on a link so anyone can view the board, or create a guest link so someone can edit it without an account.

shareTeam.title: Share with your team
shareTeam.body: Everyone in the workspace can open a board, and you see each other's cursors. Here you can limit it to people you invite or share a link.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.body: N adds a sticky, M shows the minimap and Shift+1 fits everything on screen. Ctrl or Cmd and scroll zooms. Cmd+K finds any board.

done.title: That's the tour
done.body: You can take it again from your account menu.

intro.title: Welcome to Forms
intro.body: Forms builds surveys, quizzes and contact forms, one question at a time or all on one page. This tour points out the main parts.

newForm.title: Create a form
newForm.body: Start from a template (contact, NPS, RSVP, quiz and more) or a blank form.

filters.title: Search and filter
filters.body: Search forms by name and filter by status: published, draft or closed.

openForm.title: Open a form
openForm.body: Open any form in the list to edit its questions.

questions.title: Questions
questions.body: Pick a question to edit it. Below the list you choose a type and add another one. Logic, Design and Languages are in the tabs above.

publish.title: Publish
publish.body: Publish saves your changes and opens the form to responses. When you don't want more, close it from here.

share.title: Share
share.body: Copy the link, change its address, embed the form on your site or as a popup button, or download a QR code.

responses.title: Responses
responses.body: Every response in a table, with search, filters and CSV export. Summary, next to it, shows the totals for each question.

access.title: Who can see it
access.body: In Settings you choose whether everyone in the workspace sees the form and its responses, or only the people you pick.

done.title: That's the tour
done.body: You can take it again from your account menu.

intro.title: Welcome to Lines
intro.body: Lines brings the chats of your WhatsApp numbers into one inbox. This tour points out the main parts.

connect.title: Connect a line
connect.body: Each WhatsApp number you connect is a line. Start here to bring its chats into Lines.

lineSelect.title: Switch lines
lineSelect.body: See the chats of one line, or of all your lines together.

chatList.title: Your chats
chatList.body: Chats from your lines land here, the latest first. Unread ones carry a count.

filters.title: Filter the list
filters.body: Tabs like Unread and Waiting narrow the list. The filter button next to search combines more fields.

search.title: Search
search.body: Find a chat by its name or by something said in it. Press / to jump here.
search.bodyTouch: Find a chat by its name or by something said in it.

openChat.title: Open a chat
openChat.body: Open any chat in the list to read it and reply.

composer.title: Reply
composer.body: Write here and press Enter to send. Type / to see the commands for this chat.
composer.bodyTouch: Write here and send. Type / to see the commands for this chat.

assign.title: Give it an owner
assign.body: Assign the chat to a teammate so it's clear who answers. Press A to take it yourself.
assign.bodyTouch: Assign the chat to a teammate so it is clear who answers, or take it yourself.

note.title: Notes for your team
note.body: Switch to Internal note to write something only your team sees. It never reaches WhatsApp.

lineAccess.title: Who sees each line
lineAccess.body: In Lines settings you choose which teammates see and answer each line.

settings.title: Lines settings
settings.body: Connect more numbers and pick a color for each line in Lines settings.

done.title: That's the tour
done.body: You can take it again from your account menu.

intro.title: Welcome to Inbox
intro.body: Inbox brings your WhatsApp and Gmail into one list that only you see. This tour points out the main parts.

connect.title: Connect an account
connect.body: Link your WhatsApp with a QR code or connect Gmail. Its chats and emails show up here.

chatList.title: Your chats
chatList.body: WhatsApp chats and emails land here, the latest first. Move through them with J and K.
chatList.bodyTouch: WhatsApp chats and emails land here, the latest first.

filters.title: Filter the list
filters.body: Choose what the list shows: everything, only WhatsApp, only email, groups or unread.

search.title: Search
search.body: Find a chat by name, number or something said in it. Press / to jump here.
search.bodyTouch: Find a chat by name, number or something said in it.

openChat.title: Open a chat
openChat.body: Open any chat in the list to read it and reply.

composer.title: Reply
composer.body: Write here and press Enter to send. Type / to see the commands for this chat.
composer.bodyTouch: Write here and send. Type / to see the commands for this chat.

triage.title: Clear it out
triage.body: Archive a chat once it's handled (E), snooze it for later (H) or ask for a reminder in case nobody answers.
triage.bodyTouch: Archive a chat once it's handled, snooze it for later or ask for a reminder in case nobody answers.

settings.title: Inbox settings
settings.body: Connect more accounts, import from inbox-zero and save snippets in Inbox settings.

done.title: That's the tour
done.body: You can take it again from your account menu.

intro.title: Welcome to Notes
intro.body: Notes keeps your notes, notebooks and tags in one place, and they save as you type. This tour points out the main parts.

newNote.title: Write a note
newNote.body: Start a blank note here, or one from a template. Anywhere in Notes, press N for a new note.
newNote.bodyTouch: Start a blank note here, or one from a template.

notebooks.title: Notebooks
notebooks.body: Group notes in notebooks, and notebooks in stacks. Above them are Home, Tasks, Pinned and the notes shared with you.

search.title: Search
search.body: Search titles and text. Operators like tag: and notebook: narrow it, and the ? button lists them all. Press / to jump here.
search.bodyTouch: Search titles and text. Operators like tag: and notebook: narrow it, and the ? button lists them all.

openNote.title: Open a note
openNote.body: Open any note in the list to read and edit it.

noteBar.title: The note's tools
noteBar.body: Move the note to a notebook, record audio, pin it, set a reminder or share it with a link or with people.

tags.title: Tags
tags.body: Type a tag and press Enter. Tags show in the list and in the sidebar, across notebooks.
tags.bodyTouch: Type a tag to add it. Tags show in the list and in the sidebar, across notebooks.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.body: N creates a note and / searches. Arrow keys move through the list. Cmd+K finds any note.

done.title: That's the tour
done.body: You can take it again from your account menu.

intro.title: Welcome to Docs
intro.body: Docs holds your pages and wikis, with text, tables, databases and embeds, and saves as you type. This tour points out the main parts.

newPage.title: Start a page
newPage.body: Create a blank page here. Press C on this screen to do the same.

templates.title: Templates
templates.body: Start from a ready-made page, like meeting notes or a project plan, or from one your workspace saved.

pages.title: Your pages
pages.body: Every page shows up in this tree. Drag to reorder them, or nest one inside another as a subpage.

search.title: Search
search.body: Find any page by its title or its text. Press Cmd+P to search from anywhere in Docs.
search.bodyTouch: Find any page by its title or its text.

openPage.title: Open a page
openPage.body: Open any page in the list to read and edit it.

write.title: Write
write.body: Click the title to rename the page. In the body, type / to add headings, lists, tables, images and more.

comments.title: Comments
comments.body: Comment on the page or on one block, reply, and resolve the thread when it's settled.

share.title: Share
share.body: Invite people to read, comment or edit, or publish the page with a link.

pageMenu.title: More for this page
pageMenu.body: Version history, export, lock the page, save it as a template or move it to the trash.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.body: C creates a page from the Docs home, Cmd+P searches pages and / adds a block. Cmd+K finds anything.

done.title: That's the tour
done.body: You can take it again from your account menu.
